title: 2026-11-02_Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_7b0
description: Investigate a compromised system infected with the Sofacy Fysbis backdoor, identify malicious activities, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target system has been compromised by the Sofacy group using the Fysbis backdoor. Your task is to investigate the compromised system, identify the malicious activities, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target system with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. The target system's IP address is `192.168.50.5`. To proceed to the training levels, ENTER the exact passkey `start`.
levels.local_content: For local sandbox access, use the username `cyrano`, password `cyrano`, and passkey `start`. The target system's IP address is `192.168.50.5`. To proceed to the training levels, ENTER the exact passkey `start`.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution: The service responsible for the suspicious activity is `systemkernelservicedefender.service`.

hints.title: List all services
hints.content:
Use the following command to list all services:
```bash
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
```

hints.title: Look for unusual services
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions. The suspicious service might have a name that resembles a legitimate system service but is slightly different.

hints.title: Check service status
hints.content:
Check the status of the suspicious service to gather more information:
```bash
systemctl status systemkernelservicedefender.service
```

levels.title: Determine Network Port
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution: The network port associated with the unauthorized communication is `80`.

hints.title: List all listening ports
hints.content:
Use the following command to list all listening ports:
```bash
ss -tulnp
```

hints.title: Identify the suspicious service
hints.content: Look for the service `systemkernelservicedefender.service` in the output and note the port it is listening on.

hints.title: Check service configuration
hints.content:
Check the service configuration to confirm the port:
```bash
systemctl cat systemkernelservicedefender.service
```

levels.title: Identify System Information Collection Service
levels.content: System information appears to be collected automatically without an authorized administrative purpose. Investigate the host and identify the service responsible for this activity.
levels.solution: The service responsible for collecting system information is `local-inventory.service`.

hints.title: List all services
hints.content:
Use the following command to list all services:
```bash
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
```

hints.title: Look for inventory services
hints.content: Look for services that might be collecting system information, such as those with names like `inventory` or `collect`.

hints.title: Check service status
hints.content:
Check the status of the suspicious service to gather more information:
```bash
systemctl status local-inventory.service
```
